verdict.rationale: Letta gives users real control over where agent data persists and whether it persists at all. The default local mode keeps agent state on your machine with no login, self-hosting keeps all messages, memory, and provider connections on-device, cloud backup is opt-in via /login, and `--ephemeral` runs tasks without persisting an agent, memory blocks, or MemFS. Memory is file-based and transparent, so users can inspect and shape what is kept. Missing for 10: documented deletion of agents, conversations, or memory; configurable retention periods or policies for cloud-stored data; independent corroboration of these privacy controls.
